**How to Enter & Exit:**

(1) Scan your ParkWhiz QR code at the scanner located at the entrance gate to enter.

(2) To exit, scan the same QR code at the exit gate scanner. If the overhead gate is closed at the exit, drive within two feet of the gate and it will open automatically.

**Hours & Access:**

- Hours of operation with an on-site attendant are 5:30 AM – 7:00 PM

- At 7:00 PM, overhead gates close to incoming traffic, but vehicles already inside can exit 24/7

- Pedestrian entrance to retrieve your vehicle after 7:00 PM is through the building lobby (accessible 24/7).


**Amenities:**

- There are 6 EV charging spaces available in this garage.
